title: Shinonome Ena — Happy Birthday! 2025〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Ena's birthday
Ena's Room

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm so tired from school...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I was gonna work on my art assignment before dinner, but I think I'll take a break first and—

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Huh, Rin? Why are you here all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <No reason. I just came to see you.>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Also... I heard it's your birthday today.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh... Did you come to say happy birthday to me? Thanks for going out of your way.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <That's not exactly it... But, happy birthday, Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, a message. Can you give me a second?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Okay.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um... Oh, it's from Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line:
<Hellooo!
I know I told you already, but happy birthday, Ena!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <And to mark this very special day, get a load of this! You're getting a special movie created bespoke by me, Amia!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Message
rows.Line: <With my exacting production standards, it's gonna be good enough to air on national TV. Enjoy♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: “Special movie”...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What happened?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Um, Mizuki just said, “Happy birthday,” and sent me a video.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <What kind of video?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I haven't played it yet, but... Mizuki called it a “bespoke special movie”.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, while you're still here, do you want to watch it with me?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Is that okay?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: It's a video made by Mizuki, so why not? Okay, I'm gonna hit play.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Heya! Ena, are you watching?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Ahem! Production has now officially begun on this film commemorating Ms. Ena's birthday! A round of applause, please!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey! Would a little more enthusiasm kill you?>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: <You got your applause, didn't you? From Toya, at least.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<You too Li'l Bro! Geez...
Anyway, these are my first two interviewees!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, I'll start by explaining our premise.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm asking my interviewees to tell me about their memories with Ena! I bet we're gonna hear some really surprising stories!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And so... Li'l Bro! Tell me a fond memory of your big sister that makes you all warm inside!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: <I don't have any.>

rows.Speaker: Ena's Voice
rows.Line: Excuse me? Like hell you don't. Be a bit more thoughtful, geez.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: <In that case, could I offer an anecdote?>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: <I'm fond of claw machines, but sometimes I get carried away and win far too many plushies.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: <But Ena is always willing to take them off me, which is such a help.>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: <So I'd like to take this opportunity to express my gratitude. Ena, thank you for always giving a home to the plushies I win.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Ooh, nice one Toya! Good with words as always. Unlike a certain little brother...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Oops, better skedaddle before he gets mad at me. Thanks you two!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I've got a whole lot more people to interview! Let's go!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <Now I'm here with our friends in Leo/need!>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
<Um... Hello, Ena!
When it comes to memories I have with you, the first thing that comes to mind is when you taught me to draw.>

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: <You were such a patient teacher, and you helped me learn to like art somewhat.>

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: <And Hona's been drawing for us ever since!>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: <She seriously didn't enjoy it before then... We have you to thank, Shinonome.>

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
<Thank you, Ena.
Oh, and... Let's exercise together again sometime.>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Memories with Ena...?>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <Oh, so this one time, I was watching Ena sketch a pair of goldfish!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: <She was super focused, and even though it was an incredible drawing, she still wasn't satisfied! I remember thinking how cool she was for setting such high standards.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <Yeah, Ena's super serious and cool when she's making art. Unlike her usual self! What about you, Kohane?>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Um, I competed with Ena in the Valentine's Day photo contest, and...>

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: <Her dedication to getting the best shot was so impressive! She and Airi were sprinkling petals, and...>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Happy birthday Ena! Pop pop, poppity pop pop!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <To leave you smiling, I've prepared a song for today!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <Huh?! Th-The plan was to ask you for an anecdote...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <Oh, what the heck! At times like this you gotta go with the flow!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <Alright, Emu! Take it away!>

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: <Okay☆ Start the music!!!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <You have a lot of friends, Ena.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I mean... Most of them are my juniors, so I don't know if I'd call them friends per se.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But still... I really wasn't expecting to get birthday wishes like this.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <Next, Ena, we'll interview someone I know you're dying to hear from!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Wait, I recognize this place from streams...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <And here I am, having ambushed the ladies of MORE MORE JUMP! during their break!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Memories with Ena? How long have you got? I could tell you 10 or even 20 stories!>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <Hehe, that's our Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line: <So dependable! Well then, please share a story that'll make good content♪>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Good content...? Hmm... I know, I'll tell you about this one time not long after we first became friends!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <One time, just before Ena's birthday, we sorta fell out with each other.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: <You and Ena? That's not like you two.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Exactly. We'd never fought before that, so we didn't really know how to make up. It was pretty tough.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <And then Ena's birthday came. I didn't know if I'd get to give it to her, but I brought her present to school anyway.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <Just then... I ran into Ena by the shoe lockers.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: <That must have been awkward...>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: <A-And then what happened?!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <That's just it. The second we see each other, Ena comes out with this.>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: <It's...my birthday today.>

rows.Speaker: Junior High School Ena
rows.Line: <And I want birthday wishes from you, so... Let's make up.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <And so, I got to hand her the present.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: <To this day, I still sometimes remember how Ena acted that time.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'd totally forgotten about that...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But also, I can't believe Airi remembers... It was so long ago.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Ena looks kind of happy.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki's Voice
rows.Line:
<And now...
Last but not least...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Ta-da! Who else was it gonna be?!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Well, I figured as much.
